intro.h2: Designers and builders working from one Lenexa office
paragraphs: Renovating KC handles kitchen remodeling in Kansas City from concept to completion, with its own designers, project managers and construction managers on staff. The firm works from an office in Lenexa, Kansas, and takes on homes on both the Kansas and Missouri sides of the metro.

Every kitchen starts with a conversation about what matters most to you. The design team then builds floor plans, mood boards, curated design boards and 3-D renderings, so you see the room before demolition. Licensed contractors and trusted subcontractors take it from there, and clients often thank their designer and construction manager by name in reviews.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Kansas City and the rooms around it

items.name: Kitchen Remodels and Renovations
items.blurb: Layout changes, removed walls and relocated plumbing or electrical, or a lighter renovation that swaps cabinets, counters, flooring and appliances in the same footprint. Renovating KC does both and helps you choose. Its kitchens won 2025 REMY Gold and Silver awards for Residential Kitchen Remodel.

image.alt: Kansas City kitchen remodel with an arched tile range alcove, stained wood base cabinets, white quartz island and farmhouse sink

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Spa-style primary baths, guest baths and powder rooms, large or small. In-house interior designers help you pick fixtures, tile, lighting and paint colors, and a Renovating KC bath took 2024 REMY Gold for a Residential Bathroom Remodel Under $40,000.

image.alt: Bathroom remodel with a black freestanding tub inside a glass-enclosed wet room, white stacked tile and a wood-tile accent wall

items.name: Basement Finishing
items.blurb: Home theaters, playrooms, guest suites, gyms and custom bars that turn unfinished square footage into living space. Most families stay in the house during the work. Basements earned a 2025 REMY Silver, and one recent lower level added a climbing wall, ball pit and stage.

image.alt: Finished basement bar in the Kansas City area with blue-gray cabinetry, honed black counters, under-cabinet lighting and a wall-mounted TV

items.name: Whole-Home Remodels
items.blurb: Modernizing an older house, opening the floor plan or making room for a growing family. The team coordinates every room and system on one schedule, and a whole-home project won 2024 REMY Gold for Entire House Remodel in the $200,000 to $300,000 class.

image.alt: Family room in a Renovating KC remodel with a linear fireplace, stone-look surround and navy built-in shelving

items.name: Additions and Attic Build-Outs
items.blurb: Additions and attic conversions add space you can use every day. One Google reviewer had upstairs guest rooms and an unfinished attic turned into a primary suite with vaulted ceilings, a large walk-in closet and a bath. A Renovating KC addition won 2025 REMY Gold and All-Star honors.

image.alt: Primary bathroom with a freestanding tub, checkerboard marble floor, wood vanity and arched shower opening under a vaulted ceiling

about.h2: Founded by Steven and Ben Ross in 2020
about.text: Steven Ross, Owner and President, founded Renovating KC in 2020 with Ben Ross, now Owner and VP of Construction. Derrick Thomas is also an owner and serves as VP of Strategy. The company takes on residential and commercial renovations, and the team brings over 30 years of combined experience. In 2026 Ingram's named Steven to its 40 Under Forty and listed Renovating KC among Kansas City's fastest-growing businesses. Clients mention the brothers by name: one homeowner, coordinating her late father's 1987 house from Oregon, wrote that the Ross brothers finished it in a few short months and under budget.

image.alt: Renovating KC design and construction team, Lenexa, KS

process.h2: How a Renovating KC project runs

steps.title: Project development
steps.text: A consultation covers your vision, timeline and budget. From that conversation the team writes a clear scope of work and a preliminary estimate.

steps.title: Design and planning
steps.text: Designers create floor plans, material selections, mood boards and 3-D renderings, and walk you through options until the space matches what you pictured.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: With design and schedule approved, in-house crews and trusted subcontractors build it while your project manager reports progress and checks quality.

steps.title: Warranty
steps.text: When the work is complete, Renovating KC backs your project with a full 12-month warranty and stands behind what it built.

service_area.h2: Kansas and Missouri neighborhoods we work in
service_area.text: Renovating KC is based at 14021 W 95th St in Lenexa and works across the greater Kansas City area. On the Kansas side that includes Overland Park, Leawood, Olathe, Prairie Village and Mission Hills, with Topeka at the far edge. On the Missouri side it reaches Brookside, the Country Club Plaza, Waldo, Lee's Summit, Liberty and Parkville. The full list from the firm's own service area page is below.

faq.h2: Kitchen remodel questions from Kansas City homeowners

items.q: What is the difference between a kitchen remodel and a renovation?
items.a: A renovation updates what is already there, such as cabinets, counters, flooring or appliances, without changing the layout. A remodel changes the layout itself by removing walls or moving plumbing and electrical. Renovating KC offers both and helps you pick the approach that fits your goals, budget and the way your family uses the room.

items.q: What budget should I plan for?
items.a: The kitchen and bathroom inquiry form starts at a $25,001 to $50,000 budget band, and the general consultation form starts at $50,001, with bands up to $500,000 and more for whole homes. Share your range when you reach out, and the team will build the scope of work and preliminary estimate around it.

items.q: Can we stay in the house during the work?
items.a: For basement finishing, yes: most homeowners keep living at home while the crew works efficiently and keeps the area clean. On bigger jobs it depends on scope. One client family lived in the house for the last couple of months of a near-complete gut remodel and said the crew was friendly and respectful the whole time.

items.q: What warranty comes with a project?
items.a: Every completed Renovating KC project includes a full 12-month warranty. It is the final step of the same process that starts with your consultation and runs through design and construction, and the company states plainly that it stands behind its work. Ask your project manager to walk you through what it covers.

Renovating KC works across the greater Kansas City metro from its Lenexa office, including Overland Park, Leawood, Olathe, Shawnee, Prairie Village and Mission Hills in Kansas and Brookside, Waldo, Lee's Summit, Liberty and Independence in Missouri. Call (913) 481-1236 if your town is not listed and the team will tell you.

final_cta.text: Call (913) 481-1236, Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, or request a free consultation online and the team will set up a time to talk through your kitchen.
